How this hub is built & what still needs a human

What's real vs. pending here

  • Roster group, archetypes, shooter designations, coverage calls, scout notes, Game Situations, Team Recall, Keys to Victory and the Actions & Sets call sheet are copied from the coaching staff's two completed G10 ADE data-collection templates (read 30 Oct 2026).
  • Jersey numbers, positions and heights are as given in the Personnel template.
  • C&S and Off Dribble 3P% come from the club's Opponent Shooting #s sheet (Adelaide tab). 3PA Rate, FT%, FT Rate, ORB% and AST% come from RealGM, 2023-24 to 2026-27, all competitions (Summer League and preseason excluded), weighted by games played.
  • Rigoni's RealGM sample is tiny (57 FGA, 21 GP; his NBL1 seasons are not on RealGM) and Griscti's Off Dribble 3P% rests on 7 attempts (club sheet). Mathiang's C&S / Off Dribble are blank (3PA rate under 10%). Cheat-sheet coverage calls are the per-player list Alex supplied (30 Oct). Rasmussen's C&S 3P% is NBL-only (3/31) per Alex; his Off Dribble is the 4-year club-sheet figure.

Reusing this for the next opponent

Everything on this page is driven by the data arrays at the top of the script - swap in a new opponent's roster and call sheet and the cards, quizzes, print sheet and summary rebuild themselves.
